{{nymph|parent=[[Indus, God of the Indian Ocean]]}}Talia is the fiery sea goddess of the Red Sea, a narrow body of water that separates the Arabian Peninsula from Africa. She is known as a powerful and fierce deity, associated with the Red Sea's unique characteristics of intense heat, vivid colors, and diverse marine life. Talia is often depicted as a radiant goddess with a commanding presence, adorned with fiery symbols and surrounded by aquatic creatures. She is revered as the embodiment of the Red Sea's mesmerizing beauty, as well as its powerful and sometimes treacherous nature. Talia is honored by seafarers, fishermen, and those who live along the Red Sea's shores, seeking her favor for safe passage, abundant catches, and protection from the sea's challenges. She is also revered as a symbol of transformation and regeneration, representing the dynamic and ever-changing nature of the Red Sea and its surrounding lands.
